scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix shared && npm install --prefix services/user-service && npm install --prefix services/product-service && npm install --prefix services/inventory-service && npm install --prefix services/order-service && npm install --prefix services/notification-service && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.db:setup: npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n user,product,inventory,order,notification,web -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,white "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:product" "npm run dev:inventory" "npm run dev:order" "npm run dev:notification" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix services/user-service && npm test --prefix services/product-service && npm test --prefix services/inventory-service && npm test --prefix services/order-service && npm test --prefix services/notification-service
